Unknown fields are rejected.\n\nroot\n  version     \"1\"\n  verdict     approve | request_changes | comment\n  summary     1-3 sentences, 30-1500 chars\n  ref         40-char commit SHA; leave it out, ws fills in the reviewed commit\n  profile     the profile you were primed with; one of the review's profiles\n  comments    array; empty only when verdict is approve\n  assessment  strong | sound | mixed | weak; optional, ordinal quality grade orthogonal to verdict\n\ncomment\n  id           kebab slug + number counting from 1 within each slug:\n               missing-context-1, missing-context-2, unchecked-error-1; unique\n  priority     1-10: 9-10 blocks, 7-8 should fix, 4-6 worth fixing, 1-3 optional\n  category     correctness | security | performance | maintainability | testing\n               | documentation | style\n  body         the finding and its rationale, 20-4000 chars\n  code         optional excerpt of the problem; soft\n  anchors      array of { file, line?, end_line? }; may be empty\n  suggestions  array; may be empty\n\nsuggestion\n  summary  what to do, one sentence, 10-500 chars\n  effort   trivial | small | medium | large        — how much work\n  scope    line | block | file | module | project  — blast radius\n  pros     array of strings\n  cons     array of strings\n  code     optional excerpt of the fix; soft\n\n{\"version\":\"1\",\"verdict\":\"request_changes\",\"profile\":\"go\",\"summary\":\"The retry\nloop drops the caller's deadline.\",\"comments\":[{\"id\":\"dropped-context-1\",\n\"priority\":9,\"category\":\"correctness\",\"body\":\"c.do ignores the caller's\nctx, so cancellation never propagates.\",\"anchors\":\n[{\"file\":\"internal/fetch/client.go\",\"line\":88,\"end_line\":94}],\"suggestions\":\n[{\"summary\":\"Pass the caller's ctx through to c.do\",\"effort\":\"trivial\",\n\"scope\":\"line\",\"pros\":[\"Deadlines propagate\"],\"cons\":[\"Callers see a change\"]}]\n}]}\n\nws review describe --lens=NAME opens any name below.\n",
